title: Hwhm Wholesome Algerian Snow Peas Stir-fry in Copper Mug
description: A floral, dense, romantic Algerian dish featuring snow peas cooked to perfection and served in a copper mug.
instructions: Bring a mug of water to a boil for steeping the saffron and lemon verbena.
While the mug is boiling, wash and trim the snow peas.
Heat the olive oil in a small non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the snow peas and cook until they are crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the saffron extract mixture.
Pour the dish into a heated copper mug.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves if desired.
